source_message.text: Yes, we can set it up that way. [URL_002] will serve as the master website, where visitors can learn about your brand and select a location. If someone chooses a location such as Seattle or Bay Area, they will be directed to that location's separate Wix website to make bookings and process payments. With this arrangement, every location will have its own Wix account, bookings, calendar, reporting, and payment setup, while remaining connected through the main [URL_002] website.
